description: A 2HP stereo chorus: the input is delayed by a tap that a low frequency oscillator sweeps, and the two outputs are swept half a cycle apart so the pair reads as wide

params.text: Sets the speed of the sweeping oscillator, 0.1Hz to 5Hz
Sets how far the sweep moves the delay tap, up to 10ms either side of a 15ms base delay
Crossfades between the dry input and the swept delay, all dry fully counter-clockwise and all wet fully clockwise

inputs.text: Adds to the rate knob, one hertz per volt, and the total is held between 0.1Hz and 5Hz
The audio put through the chorus

outputs.text: The input crossfaded with its swept delay, the sweep following the oscillator directly
The input crossfaded with its swept delay, the sweep taken half a cycle later than the other output's, which is what widens the pair

notes: the audio input takes polyphony and both outputs carry the same number of channels, each channel getting its own delay line and its own sweep

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
